chapters.title: How Are the Mighty Fallen
chapters.synopsis: An Amalekite brings word of Saul's death to David and claims to have slain him, and David has him executed for lifting his hand against the Lord's anointed. David then pours out his grief in a lament over Saul and Jonathan, mourning the fallen glory of Israel.

segments.speaker: chronicler
segments.note: News of Saul's death reaches David

segments.speaker: david
segments.note: David's lament for Saul and Jonathan

chapters.title: David Anointed King in Hebron
chapters.synopsis: David inquires of the Lord and goes up to Hebron, where the men of Judah anoint him king. Abner sets up Saul's son Ish-bosheth over the rest of Israel, and a bitter skirmish at Gibeon opens a long war between the two houses.

segments.speaker: chronicler
segments.note: Two kingdoms; battle at the pool of Gibeon

chapters.title: Abner Defects and Is Slain
chapters.synopsis: As David's house grows stronger, Abner breaks with Ish-bosheth and covenants to bring all Israel to David. Joab, avenging his brother, murders Abner at the gate of Hebron, and David publicly mourns to show the kingdom that the deed was not his.

segments.speaker: chronicler
segments.note: Abner's covenant with David; Joab's revenge

chapters.title: The Murder of Ish-bosheth
chapters.synopsis: Two of Ish-bosheth's own captains kill him as he sleeps and carry his head to David, expecting a reward. David condemns them for slaying a righteous man in his own house and has them executed, refusing to build his throne on blood.

segments.speaker: chronicler
segments.note: David punishes the murderers of Ish-bosheth

chapters.title: King Over All Israel
chapters.synopsis: The tribes of Israel gather to Hebron and anoint David king over the whole nation. He captures the stronghold of Zion and makes Jerusalem his city, and twice defeats the Philistines by inquiring of the Lord before battle.

segments.speaker: chronicler
segments.note: David takes Zion; Philistines defeated

chapters.title: The Ark Comes to Zion
chapters.synopsis: David brings the ark of God toward Jerusalem, but Uzzah dies when he touches it, and the ark rests three months in the house of Obed-edom. When it finally enters the city, David dances before the Lord with all his might, and Michal despises him for it.

segments.speaker: chronicler
segments.note: Uzzah smitten; David dances before the ark

chapters.title: The Lord's Covenant With David
chapters.synopsis: David desires to build a house for the Lord, but through Nathan the Lord promises instead to build David a house, an enduring dynasty whose throne will be established forever. Overwhelmed, David sits before the Lord and offers a prayer of humble gratitude for the covenant.

segments.speaker: chronicler
segments.note: David proposes a house for the Lord

segments.speaker: nathan
segments.note: The Lord's covenant of an everlasting house

segments.speaker: david
segments.note: David's prayer of thanksgiving

chapters.title: David Subdues the Nations
chapters.synopsis: David defeats the Philistines, Moab, Zobah, Syria, and Edom, dedicating the spoils of war to the Lord. The Lord preserves him wherever he goes, and he reigns over all Israel, executing judgment and justice for his people.

segments.speaker: chronicler
segments.note: David's victories and just reign

chapters.title: Kindness for Jonathan's Sake
chapters.synopsis: David asks whether anyone of Saul's house remains so that he may show kindness for Jonathan's sake. He restores all of Saul's lands to Jonathan's lame son Mephibosheth and gives him a permanent place at the king's own table.

segments.speaker: chronicler
segments.note: Mephibosheth eats at the king's table

chapters.title: War With Ammon and Syria
chapters.synopsis: The new king of Ammon humiliates David's messengers of goodwill, shaving them and cutting their garments. Ammon hires Syrian armies against Israel, but Joab and Abishai rout them, and David breaks Syria's power so that they fear to help Ammon again.

segments.speaker: chronicler
segments.note: David's messengers shamed; Syria defeated

chapters.title: David and Bath-sheba
chapters.synopsis: While his army besieges Rabbah, David remains in Jerusalem, sees Bath-sheba washing, and takes her, and she conceives. Failing to cover the sin, he arranges for her husband Uriah to die in battle and marries her, but the thing he has done displeases the Lord.

segments.speaker: chronicler
segments.note: David's sin with Bath-sheba; Uriah's death

chapters.title: Thou Art the Man
chapters.synopsis: Nathan tells David a parable of a rich man who steals a poor man's one ewe lamb, and when David's anger flares, the prophet declares, thou art the man. David confesses his sin, the child of the adultery dies despite his fasting, and Solomon is born and loved of the Lord.

segments.speaker: nathan
segments.note: The parable of the ewe lamb

segments.speaker: chronicler
segments.note: The child dies; Solomon is born

chapters.title: Amnon, Tamar, and Absalom
chapters.synopsis: David's son Amnon forces his half-sister Tamar and then despises her, and David, though angry, does nothing. After two years Absalom avenges his sister by having Amnon killed at a feast, then flees to Geshur, and David mourns for his sons.

segments.speaker: chronicler
segments.note: Tamar wronged; Absalom slays Amnon

chapters.title: The Wise Woman of Tekoah
chapters.synopsis: Joab sends a wise woman of Tekoah with a feigned story to move the king to bring back his banished son. David allows Absalom to return to Jerusalem, but two full years pass before the handsome prince is admitted to see his father's face.

segments.speaker: chronicler
segments.note: A parable of banishment; Absalom restored

chapters.title: Absalom Steals Israel's Heart
chapters.synopsis: Absalom sits in the gate flattering every man with a suit, stealing the hearts of the men of Israel, then raises rebellion at Hebron. David flees Jerusalem barefoot and weeping over the mount of Olives, sending the ark back and planting Hushai as his friend in Absalom's court.

segments.speaker: chronicler
segments.note: The conspiracy; David flees the city

chapters.title: Shimei Curses the Fleeing King
chapters.synopsis: As David flees, Ziba slanders Mephibosheth, and Shimei of Saul's house hurls stones and curses at the king. David restrains his men, saying the Lord may have bidden it, while in Jerusalem Absalom takes his father's concubines on the advice of Ahithophel.

segments.speaker: chronicler
segments.note: Shimei's curses; Ahithophel counsels Absalom

chapters.title: Hushai Defeats Ahithophel's Counsel
chapters.synopsis: Ahithophel asks to strike David at once while he is weary, but Hushai counsels delay, and the Lord ordains that his counsel prevail to bring evil on Absalom. Word is smuggled to David, who crosses the Jordan to Mahanaim, while Ahithophel hangs himself.

segments.speaker: chronicler
segments.note: Counsel overthrown; David escapes over Jordan

chapters.title: O Absalom, My Son
chapters.synopsis: David's forces defeat Absalom's army in the wood of Ephraim, where the rebel prince is caught by his hair in an oak and slain by Joab despite the king's charge to deal gently with him. When the news reaches David he goes up to the chamber over the gate weeping, O my son Absalom, would God I had died for thee.

segments.speaker: chronicler
segments.note: Battle in the wood; Absalom slain

segments.speaker: chronicler
segments.note: The tidings; David weeps for his son

chapters.title: David Returns to His Throne
chapters.synopsis: Joab rouses the mourning king to encourage his people, and Judah brings David back over the Jordan. On the way David pardons Shimei, hears Mephibosheth's defense, and blesses aged Barzillai, while jealousy flares between Israel and Judah over the king's return.

segments.speaker: chronicler
segments.note: Pardons at the Jordan; the king restored

chapters.title: Sheba's Revolt Is Crushed
chapters.synopsis: Sheba the son of Bichri blows a trumpet and draws Israel away from David. Joab murders his rival Amasa on the pursuit, then besieges Sheba in Abel, where a wise woman persuades the city to throw down the rebel's head and spare the town.

segments.speaker: chronicler
segments.note: Rebellion of Sheba; a wise woman's counsel

chapters.title: Famine, Gibeonites, and Giants
chapters.synopsis: A three-year famine is traced to Saul's slaughter of the Gibeonites, and David makes atonement by delivering seven of Saul's descendants, while Rizpah's long vigil moves him to bury Saul's bones. The chapter closes with Israel's champions slaying four giant warriors of the Philistines.

segments.speaker: chronicler
segments.note: Atonement for the Gibeonites; giant wars

chapters.title: David's Song of Deliverance
chapters.synopsis: David sings to the Lord in the day of his deliverance from all his enemies, calling him his rock, fortress, and deliverer. The psalm recounts how God heard him in distress, thundered from heaven, and rewarded his righteousness, showing mercy to his anointed for evermore.

segments.speaker: chronicler
segments.note: David sings in the day of deliverance

segments.speaker: david
segments.note: The Lord is my rock and fortress

chapters.title: Last Words and Mighty Men
chapters.synopsis: In his last words David testifies that the Spirit of the Lord spoke by him and that he who rules justly over men must rule in the fear of God. The chronicler then honors David's mighty men, including the three who broke through the Philistine host to draw him water from the well of Bethlehem.

segments.speaker: david
segments.note: The last words of David

segments.speaker: chronicler
segments.note: The roll of David's mighty men

chapters.title: The Census and the Altar
chapters.synopsis: David numbers Israel and Judah, then his heart smites him and he confesses his sin. Choosing to fall into the hand of the Lord rather than of men, he watches a pestilence slay seventy thousand until the angel stays at Araunah's threshingfloor, where David buys the site and builds an altar, refusing to offer what costs him nothing.

segments.speaker: chronicler
segments.note: Plague stayed; an altar at the threshingfloor
